# Atana

> Atana is a workplace culture and training platform that combines behavioral intelligence, compliance training, and organizational insights to drive culture transformation and risk reduction.

Atana provides comprehensive training courses, AI-powered analytics, and industry-specific solutions to help organizations improve workplace safety, compliance, employee engagement, and organizational culture. The platform serves diverse industries including retail, hospitality, healthcare, manufacturing, and government.

## Key Topics

- Behavioral Intelligence
- Compliance Training
- Workplace Culture
- DEI & Respectful Workplace
- Harassment Prevention
- Workplace Safety
- Organizational Insights
- Employee Engagement
- Manager Training
- Risk Reduction
- Culture Transformation
- M&A Integration
- Atana Insights
- Atana AI
- I/O Psychology

## Core Platform

- [Atana](https://www.atana.com): Atana homepage introducing workplace culture and training solutions
- [Atana Insights](https://www.atana.com/product/insights): Atana Insights product for measuring workplace training and analytics
- [Atana AI](https://www.atana.com/product/ai): Atana AI assistant for workforce analytics and organizational insights

## Training Courses

- [How Was Your Day?: Respect in the Workplace](https://www.atana.com/courses/how-was-your-day): How Was Your Day course on respectful workplace and DEI training
- [Overcoming Unconscious & Implicit Bias](https://www.atana.com/courses/unintentional-still-hurts): Unintentional Still Hurts course on unconscious bias and diversity
- [Once & For All: Workplace Sexual Harassment Training](https://www.atana.com/courses/once-and-for-all): Once & For All sexual harassment prevention training with compliance
- [Getting Real About Workplace Violence](https://www.atana.com/courses/getting-real-about-workplace-violence): Getting Real About Workplace Violence training for safety awareness
- [Difficult Conversations Training for Managers](https://www.atana.com/courses/uncomfortable-conversations): Manager training on difficult conversations and communication skills
- [Workplace Culture & Communication Training Courses](https://www.atana.com/courses): Atana training courses for workplace culture and compliance

## Solutions

- [Risk Management](https://www.atana.com/solutions/risk-reduction): Risk reduction solution combining compliance and behavior change
- [Performance & Productivity](https://www.atana.com/solutions/performance-productivity): Performance and productivity improvement through behavioral intelligence
- [Cultural Transformation](https://www.atana.com/solutions/culture-transformation): Cultural transformation solution using behavioral science and insights
- [M&A Integration](https://www.atana.com/solutions/merger-integration): M&A integration solution for cultural alignment and change management

- [Retail](https://www.atana.com/industries/retail-industry): Atana solutions for retail industry employee training and safety
- [Hospitality](https://www.atana.com/industries/hospitality-industry): Atana solutions for hospitality industry compliance and culture
